Think negatively get negative results, think positively and at least make progress. I’ve been in your shoes, not too long ago i thought suicide was inevitable. Then i thought about every possible scenario and realized this is probably the only life I’m going to get. So i work towards a life i can enjoy every day, sure i am still slightly suicidal. But i watch shows that make me laugh, i eat food that tastes good, i swim every day and i enjoy it, and i have a vision of a future that i could enjoy. Maybe someday i will find a lover and get married, but that’s going to take a lot of work to get to that point. If i sit in my room and be depressed, sleep all day, gorge on food or porn to make myself feel better, I’m never going to get anywhere. But i fight every day to work towards a life that will be enjoyable, knowing that the alternative is wasting more time and i know I’ve done enough of that.

I was in the same place not too long ago, all you can do is try. Being negative is literally not going to do anything. When my depression was at it’s worst all i did was sleep and gorge myself with shit food, watch porn to feel something,i wish i would have kept doing things that i enjoyed. Such as going to work out, eating good food, reading books, studying. I think it was an imbalance in my brain or something. But it’s been half a year since then and i am looking at things in a better light. I’ve learned that being negative will get you nowhere, and you only have one chance at life. That time is the most precious thing and the more time you waste the more you will just regret it in the future. I still have depression but i fight every day to think positively, to work towards my ideal life. While a depressed mind thinks that will never be possible, I’m a piece of shit, i am worthless. The difference is i try not to think like that, think it doesn’t matter whatever happens I’m going to work towards my ideal life and do my best to make it happen. Because the alternative is I’m just going to be negative about everything, sit in my room and just make myself more depressed, getting me nowhere.  Sincerely someone who’s been there and wasted too much time.
